correctness.rationale: The partial derivatives force projective singularities x=1, y=t, z=t^-2, t^7=1 and unique w=t², so there are seven singular points in Frobenius orbits 1+3+3. Expanding the quadratic tangent cone Q_t=t^-1 u²+t² uv+t^-2 v², substitution h=t³j gives j²+j+1=0, hence nonsplit over odd-degree F2 extensions and split over even degree. Nonzero cross term yields analytically an A3 local model UV+s^4; the 3-component exceptional chain contributes q replacement points over nonsplit tangent vs 3q over split, with net q or 3q. Radicial projection V→P² over every F_{2^n} gives exactly q²+q+1 points, and the exceptional correction produces the formula. Frobenius component cycles 1^1 2^1 3^2 6^2 plus hyperplane match 22 divisor dimensions; rational zeta product follows from finite-field counting for all n. Independent GF(2^n) projective enumeration checked n=1..6, singular counts 1,1,7,1,1,7 and resolved counts 9,33,129,321,1089,5505. Universal formula comes from explicit local geometry rather than finite extension extrapolation.
